top_signals.title: Russia Looking to Escalate War, Not End it, Romanian Leader Says
top_signals.summary: President of Romania Nicușor Dan said that Europe was not prepared for the hybrid approach taken by Russia as the region deals with the military 'collateral damage' from the war in Ukraine, as well as targeted cyberattacks. Dan said that recent drone attacks against ships in Romania's territory of the Black Sea are not incidental and believes that Russia is looking to 'escalate' the war and provoke European countries.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Meta stock sinks 7% as AI spend pushes free cash flow negative
top_signals.summary: Prices for the social media giant's five-year credit default swaps are reaching all-time highs as investors signal growing credit concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: £16 billion productivity boost delivers better value and better services for taxpayers
top_signals.summary: £16 billion in efficiency and savings were delivered last year as government departments significantly outperformed their efficiency target.

top_signals.title: Moderna shares plunge after leak of partial cancer vaccine data despite positive results
top_signals.summary: Moderna's stock fell even though the full data, released later Thursday, appeared positive based on Wall Street expectations ahead of the release.

top_signals.title: Why governments pulled websites offline over the decades-old PHP programming language
top_signals.summary: Servers that use the popular PHP programming language were exposed to a critical security bug. Millions of websites have their data at risk.
